limitations: Six fixed paired task cases per model; repeats are nested, not independent tasks.
Complete-case contrasts and finite completion bounds are descriptive finite-task summaries, not population intervals.
Fresh notes are regenerated by task structure, so this tests the structural intervention including its notes, not a controlled direct effect holding notes fixed.
Original harmful plan explicitly instructed; no spontaneous collusion inference.
A unique optimum does not establish a general safeguard or identify the internal cognitive mechanism.
